title: More to make in Play and the API
summary:
October brought more ways to make and publish things, with better tools for managing access, finding models, and handling awkward API requests.

Play became a playground for image, video, and audio generation. New models expanded speech, video, image editing, 3D, chat, and typed decisions. Video sound effects and asynchronous media jobs gave builders more ways to work with generated media.

Linux sandboxes gained longer runs, dashboard controls, agent tools, and Azure templates. Static hosting at `<name>.pollinations.app` added a path from a built app to a public URL, including deployment through Polli, the SDK, and MCP.

Keys gained model-specific limits, grant links for missing permissions, and clearer consent flows. Google sign-in and Pollinations Connect made accounts easier to use. Starting November 1, `pk_` App Keys identify OAuth apps but no longer authenticate API requests; generation needs an `sk_` key or a user-authorized key.

More community apps joined the catalog, and My Apps gave builders a place to see their listings. Model search, rankings, health reports, and Community Watch made model choice easier to inspect. Quests gained new rewards and clearer standings.
